purpose: Which assetPlan alias slugs (world/sources/catalogue/asset-aliases.json) a place record may carry, by the record's culture and secondaryCultures (decision 0100 decision 7: a kit the place's culture does not use is a record defect). Each row lists the inventory family cultures it admits and the slugs those families resolve to; test_record_services.py holds the two in step and checks every record.

shellFamiliesPurpose: Regional building styles (owner walk 11 item 6c/6d): every building shell a place may stand as its main house belongs to one family, named by kit and asset id (each id is a row of that kit's config in tooling/asset-pipeline/pipeline/config/kits/); regionalStyles says which families are home in each culture region, which may visit (the top shell family of at most one place in that region, heldBy naming the place when two compete) and treats every other family as foreign. Gate breadth.province (worldgen/shell_breadth.py) reads the published bundles against this table and breadth-bars.json province bars.
